from.place: proof, part (<=): the assertion that the global-sections field k' is separable over k

title: Separability of global sections
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be a smooth projective curve over $k$ [def-pc-smooth-projective-curve], and put $k'=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$. Assume that the structure map makes $k'/k$ a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. Then $k'/k$ is separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension].

source.place: Lemma 0BUG (lemma-proper-geometrically-reduced-global-sections), clause (4): separability of H^0(X,O_X) over k for proper geometrically reduced X
